resolution: The q.14 local interface represents aptitude for another's form; it does not assert an actual input event. Sense has without-matter reception already, so this capacity is not the intellectual grade of DEF-HAS-INTELLECT. The old divine HasIntellect remains primitive; God is not represented as passively acquiring creaturely information. q.14 a.1 ad 1–3 removes created habit, potency and multiplicity from divine predication. The q.75 human cognitive-scope relation is not silently identified with either divine knowledge or this reception interface. No equivalence to operational, functional or computational knowing is asserted.
